Fix minimality: git diff b5cab6da..707ddd3e -- dashboard/scripts/rebuild-map.ts shows exactly two hunks. Hunk 1 adds the groups guard to readKeepGroups (rebuild-map.ts:92-99). Empty or missing groups input: the new guard throws inside main's existing try, so main prints the message and the usage, returns 2, and never reaches the write. The B-F1 tests (rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts:154-176) place a sentinel in the out file and assert exit 2 with the sentinel intact. Both passed in my gate run. At b5cab6da the same tests failed with exit 0 (green-7r-r2-red-rerun.txt, 3 failed), which proves fail-first: the pristine code overwrote the out file with an empty map.

Write failure: the B-F2 test (rebuild-map.adversarial.test.ts:180-191) gives a missing out folder, asserts exit 2, usage on stderr, zero '    at ' stack lines, and no created folder. It failed at b5cab6da with an uncaught ENOENT from the write (green-7r-r2-red-rerun.txt) and passes now. The guard covers the routed missing-folder class; a mid-write disk-full failure is outside the routed defect and stays uncontracted.
